test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**where**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**where**'.
 
• It means **'at, in, or to which (used after reference to a place or situation).'** [पर, में, या जिसमें (किसी स्थान या स्थिति के संदर्भ में प्रयुक्त)]
 
 
• Example: We came to a village, **where** we stopped for lunch.<
